description: Search emails by criteria (from, to, subject, text, date range). By default searches the local inbox only. Set searchRelay=true to also search the connected Gmail/Outlook account — results include relay UIDs that can be imported with import_relay_email.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

searchRelay.description: Also search the connected Gmail/Outlook account (default: false). Use this to find past emails from the user's main inbox.

name: search_emails
